title: 更好的联机 / Better Multiplayer
description:
[h1]更好的联机[/h1]
保留游戏原生好友联机，并增加篝火物品交易、帮助队友锻造和商店金币交易。

[h2]主要功能[/h2]
[list]
[*]使用游戏原生好友联机流程
[*]在篝火交换卡牌、遗物和药水
[*]消耗自己的篝火行动，为队友升级一张牌
[*]在商店中与队友交换金币
[/list]

[h1]Better Multiplayer[/h1]
Keeps the native friends-only multiplayer flow and adds Rest Site item trades, Smith for a Teammate, and gold trading at merchants.

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Use the game's native friends multiplayer flow
[*]Trade Cards, Relics, and Potions at Rest Sites
[*]Spend your Rest Site action to upgrade a card for another player
[*]Trade gold with another player at merchants
[/list]
changeNote:
[h1]0.7.1 交易界面修复 / Trade UI Fixes[/h1]

修复金币交易和遗物交易按钮无响应，并恢复官方按钮边框。

Fixed unresponsive gold and relic trade buttons and restored the official button borders.
